coverage_evidence: Suspended tenants block new attempt creation before pinning while an existing IN_PROGRESS attempt resumes without the new-attempt guard.
Draft/orchestration suspension guard rejects createDraft before billing/template/session side effects.
Active identity facade rejects wrong tenant, wrong role, suspended, and deleted students/proctors; batch audience expansion filters inactive identities in one lookup.
Enrollment and proctor assignment reject ineligible identities before persistence; preview audience remains read-only.
Tenant suspension HTTP contract and active notification recipient regressions pass.
limitations: No Postgres concurrency/integration test was added in this phase; enrollment serialization and publish reconciliation are Phase 15 scope.
No live production, deployment, or browser verification is claimed.
The full API regression suite was not used as the Phase 14 gate; evidence is limited to the listed focused suites and compile gate.
